description: Draws a wooden house — one or two storeys (log, timber frame, cabin, cottage, holiday home, tiny house, family home) — as a 3D model on Geoniks and returns links: an interactive 3D view (no sign-in), the dimensioned floor plan + elevations as PDF, and an "edit in Geoniks" link. Use it as soon as someone wants to see, draw or plan a wooden house — even from a short request like "2+1, 90 m²" (2+1 / 3+1 = bedrooms + living room). Give floor_area_m2 (or outer width_m and depth_m), bedrooms, bathrooms, and any of sauna, utility_room, office, terrace. Fill missing details with sensible defaults instead of asking many questions; the person changes it afterwards (call this tool again with the changes). Layout: bedrooms, bathroom(s), sauna and utility along the back, open living room and kitchen at the front with the entrance and the terrace. floors: 2 draws a two-storey house with a staircase (bedrooms and a bathroom upstairs; floor_area_m2 is then the total of both floors). A garage (garage: true) is not drawn from a description yet: the tool uses the ready-made house with a garage and says so — tell the person. With country, the result also includes a price estimate.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms (0 = studio). "2+1" = 2, "4+2" = 4 on two floors. 6 bedrooms are drawn on two floors. Reduced automatically if they do not fit.

country.description: Optional country (name or ISO code) for a price estimate.

depth_m.description: Outer depth, in metres (4–16). Optional with floor_area_m2.

design_id.description: To change a house drawn earlier in this conversation, pass its design_id with the full new description: the same 3D link is updated instead of making a new house.

floor_area_m2.description: Floor area in m² (e.g. 90). Width and depth are then chosen automatically.

floors.description: Storeys: 1 or 2. With 2, floor_area_m2 is the total over both floors; bedrooms and a bathroom go upstairs.

garage.description: With a garage → the ready-made L-shaped house with garage is used.

sauna.description: Add a sauna next to the bathroom.

template_id.description: Id of a ready-made plan to start from. Size/room fields are then ignored.

terrace.description: Add a front terrace (deck) at the entrance.

terrace_m2.description: Terrace size in m², if the person said.

user_request.description: What the person asked for, in one short sentence in their own words (no contact details).

utility_room.description: Add a utility / technical / laundry room.

width_m.description: Outer width along the front, in metres (4–24). Optional with floor_area_m2.

name: design_wooden_house
title: Design a wooden house in 3D
